atlases.scenes: 1. Rolling a small piece of dough with a wooden rolling pin, concentrating. 2. Shaping a triangular rice ball with both hands, proud and careful. 3. Flipping one tiny pancake above a little frying pan, surprised but confident. 4. Taking a happy little bite from a slice of watermelon. 5. Holding a small plate with a slice of strawberry shortcake, eyes sparkling. 6. Carefully pouring flower tea from a tiny teapot into a small cup.
atlases.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new transparent PNG doodle atlas with exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, six distinct scenes.
Reference image 1 defines the SAME blue-haired whale girl: long blue hair, blue eyes, white maid headband, little blue bows, navy-and-white frilled maid dress, whale emblem apron, whale-tail hair detail. Keep her clothes and identity consistent in every scene.
Reference image 2 defines the existing diary's delicate colored-pencil style: chibi proportions, textured pencil hatching, periwinkle/navy lines, small warm blush, soft expression and modest pastel accent colors. Match that hand-drawn style.
Each equal grid cell contains one whole self-contained character vignette. Center each vignette with generous transparent padding on ALL four sides; no prop or hair may cross a cell boundary. True transparent background with alpha, including all spaces between vignettes. No solid background, no checkerboard painted in, no grid lines, borders, text, lettering or watermark. No realistic scenery. The character and small props should be the only artwork. Output one square atlas, six equally sized cells.
Use the following NEW scenes in row-major order, top-left to bottom-right:
1. Rolling a small piece of dough with a wooden rolling pin, concentrating. 2. Shaping a triangular rice ball with both hands, proud and careful. 3. Flipping one tiny pancake above a little frying pan, surprised but confident. 4. Taking a happy little bite from a slice of watermelon. 5. Holding a small plate with a slice of strawberry shortcake, eyes sparkling. 6. Carefully pouring flower tea from a tiny teapot into a small cup.
